info.name: Class Management API
info.description: End-to-end collection for the Class Management API: Auth, Admin Subjects, and Admin User Management. Auth is cookie-based — run 'Auth / Login (Admin)' first and Postman's cookie jar carries access_token/refresh_token to the rest of the requests. Set {{baseUrl}} via the environment.

request.description: Logs in the self-registered student created by 'Register (Student)' (uses {{selfEmail}}).

item.name: Teacher Classes
item.description: Login (Teacher) first. Create Class captures {{classId}}; Get Class / Regenerate capture {{inviteCode}}; List Members (Pending) captures {{membershipId}}.

request.description: subjectId = an active catalog subject's publicId (e.g. {{subjectId}}); OR leave null and set subjectName for a free-text subject; OR both null for no subject.

item.name: Student Classes
item.description: Login (Student) first. Join uses {{inviteCode}} captured from the teacher's Get Class.

item.name: Admin Classes
item.description: Login (Admin) first. Read-only overview of all classes.

request.description: Run first as a Teacher (or anyone) to capture an active {{subjectId}} for question creation.

body.raw:
{
  "subjectId": "{{subjectId}}",
  "type": "SingleChoice",
  "content": "What is 2 + 2? Choose the correct answer.",
  "difficulty": "Easy",
  "suggestedPoint": 1,
  "visibility": "Private",
  "explanation": "Basic arithmetic.",
  "options": [
    { "content": "3", "isCorrect": false },
    { "content": "4", "isCorrect": true },
    { "content": "5", "isCorrect": false }
  ],
  "tags": ["arithmetic", "grade-1"]
}

request.description: Create a question in the teacher's bank. type ∈ SingleChoice|MultipleChoice|TrueFalse|ShortWriting|LongWriting. Options apply to choice types only (TrueFalse seeds True/False server-side). Requires an active {{subjectId}}.

body.raw:
{
  "subjectId": null,
  "type": "ShortWriting",
  "content": "Explain Newton's second law in your own words.",
  "difficulty": "Medium",
  "suggestedPoint": 2,
  "visibility": "Private",
  "explanation": null,
  "options": [],
  "tags": ["physics"]
}

request.description: Subject is OPTIONAL - send subjectId null (e.g. when no catalog subject exists yet).
Filters (add as query params): subjectId, type, difficulty, visibility, tag, searchTerm.

body.raw:
{
  "subjectId": "{{subjectId}}",
  "type": "SingleChoice",
  "content": "Updated: what is 3 + 4? Choose the correct answer.",
  "difficulty": "Medium",
  "suggestedPoint": 2,
  "visibility": "Private",
  "explanation": "Updated explanation.",
  "options": [
    { "content": "6", "isCorrect": false },
    { "content": "7", "isCorrect": true }
  ],
  "tags": ["arithmetic"]
}

request.description: Duplicates a Public or owned question into the caller's bank as a new Private copy.
All Public questions from any teacher (read-only). Same filters as the bank list minus visibility.
Admin read-only list of every question (including Private). Login as Admin first.

item.name: Output Cache (manual perf)
item.description:
Verify output caching + tag eviction by hand. Login (Admin) first.
1) Run 'GET Subjects (1st — cache miss)' then 'GET Subjects (2nd — cache HIT)': the 2nd should be noticeably faster (served from cache, no DB hit) — each request logs its responseTime to the Postman console.
2) Run 'Create Subject (evicts cache)', then 'GET Subjects (after evict — fresh)': the list reflects the new subject immediately (the write evicted the 'subjects' tag).
Note: responses also vary by Accept-Language and (for teacher/student endpoints) by the signed-in user.

exec: console.log('2nd GET /subjects responseTime =', pm.response.responseTime, 'ms (should be faster on a cache hit)');
